Test Weight |
1¢ each 1 pound or fraction from 53.9# to 52#
3¢ each 1 pound or fraction from 51.9# to 50#
5c each 1 pound or fraction from 49.9# to 49#
Subject to rejection under 49.0 lb. |
Moisture |
1.6% shrink per point above 15.5% to 19%, broken to the nearest tenth
Above 19% subject to rejection or discount as agreed upon by HOMELAND AND SELLER Please Call Before Delivery |
Damage |
2¢ each 1% or fraction from 5.1% to 7.0%
3¢ each 1% or fraction from 7.1% to 10.0%
4¢ each 1% or fraction from 10.1% to 15.0%
Above 15.0% subject to rejection or discount as agreed upon by HOMELAND AND SELLER |
Foreign Material |
1¢ each 1% or fraction from 5.1% to 7.0%
1.5¢ each 1% or fraction above 7.1% to 9.0%
3¢ each 1% or fraction above 9.1% to 10.0%
Above 10.0% subject to rejection or discount as agreed upon by HOMELAND AND SELLER |
Heat Damage |
1¢ each .1% or fraction from .3% to .5%
2¢ each ½% or fraction from .6% to 5.0%
Above 5.0% subject to rejection or discount as agreed upon by HOMELAND AND SELLER |
Subject to Rejection |
